name: Adam Apollo
reason: Held for the owner (judgement call, 4 Nov 2026), not a rule skip: his own site (adamapollo.com) is reachable, has a contact form (/get-in-touch/), books (The Dragon Key; a chapter in Sacred Stories' Lifetimes) and a YouTube channel, but (1) its home page features his April 2026 statement 'On Sovereignty & Assault' answering public accusations by another spiritual speaker that a 2022 encounter was predatory, and (2) his current main offering, The Gatework Protocol, is about contacting 'Hyperintelligent Beings' channelled through ChatGPT. Listing him seems an owner decision; no Shift Network course is named on his site. His current paid offerings are thin (private weekend intensives, a waiting list; the USS Apollo course was March 2023). robots.txt asks for a 10-second crawl delay, which was kept.
